title: Can AI data centers be mass-produced like cars? This startup aims to find out
hook_text: AI data centers built in 48 hours
script:
Startup Runware is building a factory to mass-produce prefabricated AI data centers on an assembly line.
The company aims to get these modular units online in just forty-eight hours.
Traditional facilities take months to build and wire up for heavy computing loads.
Runware is betting standardizing the hardware will slash construction costs.
The real test is whether Runware can deliver these units at true scale.
Would you trust a prefab data center?
